name: Phil Carlos
intro: Hi, I’m Phil — a curious AI builder and designer.
about: My exploration began with architectural design and gradually moved toward the intersection of AIGC, interaction design, and the internet.
I enjoy working with AI to make sense of fuzzy ideas, then bring them to life.
Formulasearch is my personal practice hub, a home for my projects, blog posts, Skills, and tools. Some come from independent exploration; others are made with collaborators.
interest: Outside of vibe coding, I also enjoy photography and travel, occasionally leaving a little of the scenery, everyday moments, and fragments I find along the way here.
sponsor: If something I share is useful to you, you are welcome to buy me a coffee. Thank you.
